title: Milkable Squids
description: Make squids milkable like in the beta.
body:
Milkable Squids is a lightweight plugin that makes you able to milk squids like in beta minecraft!

Features:
- Milkable Squids (like in beta).
- Plays a cow milked sound when milked.
- Can be milked in offhand.
